caption_fb:
Why is my family's record in Latin, Polish or Russian?

In much of Poland the priest also kept the civil records, so the language followed the empire:
🔹 Galicia (Austrian): Latin, from 1782
🔹 Russian partition: Polish from 1808, Russian from 1868

One family can appear in two languages without ever moving.

The good news: every record holds the same five facts. Date, child, parents, godparents, village. Learn where they sit on the page and you can read all three.
